verdict.rationale: Clerk documents a public Backend API with a published OpenAPI spec (probe confirmed HTTP 200 at /openapi.json with an "openapi" key). Personal access tokens authenticate programmatic Backend API calls, API keys and M2M tokens cover machine callers, and new endpoints and an open-source tool built on the Backend API show active use and maintenance. A community report calls Clerk's frontend API sparsely documented, though that does not contradict the Backend API. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of driving the Backend API end-to-end, and evidence that the frontend API surface is thoroughly documented.
